title: The counting chamber above the reservoir, under the Stone Wastes. Q-MAIN-26, 27 and 28 are given by Ixtu-Meer here and Q-MAIN-32 by Keeper Teeja-Lun at the sapwell under the rib; all four are main-quest gates whose giver had no place in the world. Same reasoning as rootlands-hollow: settlement:null is the honest record for somebody who belongs to no town, so the placement is by `site`.
